title: Article 39A — Equal justice and free legal aid

content.overview: Article 39A directs the State to secure that the operation of the legal system promotes justice on a basis of equal opportunity and to provide free legal aid, by suitable legislation or schemes, so that opportunities for securing justice are not denied by economic or other disabilities.

sections.heading: Equal justice and legal aid
sections.body: Article 39A underpins legal-services legislation and schemes. It connects access to justice with equality and fairness in the legal system's operation.

sections.heading: Knowledge graph links
sections.body: Related constitutional anchors often invoked in practice: Articles 14 and 21 (equality and fair procedure), and Article 39's justice-oriented policy. Legal-aid delivery is statutory and institutional.

sections.heading: Track B
sections.body: For an individual client's representation needs, use the legal-services institution and the relevant statute or scheme. Article 39A explains policy; it does not replace the statutory gateway.
